leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement the useFetch composable to fetch data from an API endpoint
Configure the useFetch composable with options like immediate execution and response type
Initialize reactive state variables to store fetched data, loading status, and error messages
Manipulate the fetched data by transforming or filtering the response before display
Bind the loading and error states to conditional UI elements in your template
Control when the fetch executes by triggering it based on user interactions or component lifecycle
Integrate the useFetch composable into a Vue component to display dynamic data
